columns.name: department
columns.description: 부서 (인사팀, 마케팅팀, 영업팀, 개발팀, 재무팀, 기획팀, 운영팀 등)

columns.name: job_title
columns.description: 직무 (인사담당, 마케터, 백엔드 개발자, 재무분석가 등)

columns.name: job_grade
columns.description: 직급 (사원, 대리, 과장, 차장, 부장 등)

sample_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees WHERE department = '개발팀'
SELECT emp_id, name, department, job_title, hire_date FROM employees WHERE job_grade = '부장' ORDER BY hire_date
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT emp_id, name, department, hire_date FROM employees WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2020-01-01' ORDER BY hire_date
